sidebar.title: Connections
sidebar.noOpenConnection: Connect to a database to search its objects
sidebar.emptyHint: Create a connection to start browsing a database.

row.readOnlyAppOnlyHint: This server has no read-only session mode: writes are blocked by DBStudio, not by the server.

confirm.deleteProfileBody: The connection is removed and, if it is currently open, disconnected first. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteGroupBody: Connections and groups inside it are not deleted; they move up to the parent group.

password.title: Password required
password.description: "{{name}}" does not store a password. Enter it to connect.

field.name: Name
field.readOnlyHint: Block every statement that writes data.
field.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
field.savePasswordHint: Stored in the system keychain. When off, you are asked each time you connect.
field.authModeNoneHint: The server needs no login: no password is asked, stored or sent. A saved password is removed when you save.

validation.portRange: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
validation.timeoutPositive: Timeout must be a positive whole number

tlsHint.disable: No encryption. Everything, including the password, travels in plain text.
tlsHint.prefer: Encrypts when the server supports it, otherwise silently falls back to plain text.
tlsHint.require: Always encrypts, but does not check the server certificate.
tlsHint.verifyCa: Encrypts and checks the certificate against the CA, but not the host name.
tlsHint.verifyFull: Encrypts and checks both the CA and that the host name matches. Recommended.

tlsWarning.disable: Traffic is not encrypted, so the password can be read by anyone on the network. Use Verify full (CA and host name) for remote servers.
tlsWarning.prefer: This mode can fall back to unencrypted traffic, and never verifies the server, so an attacker on the network can intercept the password. Use Verify full (CA and host name).
tlsWarning.require: Traffic is encrypted but the server certificate is not verified, so a man-in-the-middle can still intercept the password. Use Verify full (CA and host name).

search.currentDbOnly: Searching only in database {{database}}. Open another database to search there.

slow.keychain: Waiting for the system to grant access to the Keychain / password store - check the operating system dialog.
slow.generic: Still waiting for the connection or for access to the system password store...

localDc.label: Local datacenter
localDc.hint: Datacenter whose nodes are preferred. Empty: taken from the first node.

lwtEdits.label: Edit rows with lightweight transactions
lwtEdits.hint: IF EXISTS / IF NOT EXISTS detects rows changed by someone else. Slower; turn off for tables where LWT is not allowed.

singleNode.label: Use only the contact host
singleNode.hint: Do not connect to the other nodes of the cluster (always on through an SSH tunnel).

secure.label: Transport
secure.hint: Automatic follows the TLS mode above.

editing.label: Data editing
editing.hint: Updates and deletes run as mutations; insert only turns them off.

cluster.label: Cluster routing id
cluster.hint: CockroachDB Cloud only, for example funny-otter-1234.

health.leasesBroken_one: One open transaction was lost with the connection; it was not replayed.
health.leasesBroken_other: {{count}} open transactions were lost with the connection; they were not replayed.
health.leasesReopened_one: One query tab got a new server session: SET values and temporary tables are gone.
health.leasesReopened_other: {{count}} query tabs got a new server session: SET values and temporary tables are gone.
